heading: This Afternoon
text: Sunny. Valley highs in the low to mid 50s in the south, and mid 40s to around 50 north. North winds 5 to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Clear through midnight; a few high clouds late, mainly west of the Greens. Lows from the upper teens to mid 20s, except low to mid teens in northern cold hollows. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Sun filtering through high clouds. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s north, and mid to upper 50s in the south. South to southeast winds 5 to 10 mph.
